task: Finish AP, IB, IGCSE and CBSE content: bounded curriculum coverage repair
scope: Original IB DP microeconomics and thermal Physics practice using existing ExamDrill and FormulaReference types, plus the adopted CBSE subject gap inventory.

adoptedMapEvidence.limitation: The configured CBSE grade range is an onboarding range, not a claim that each subject applies in every class. Adopted class, syllabus year and subject specifications remain unknown.

concreteRepair: Six original economics drills distinguish private/social curves, negative production and consumption externalities, positive consumption externalities, emissions charges and price ceilings.
Four original Physics drills cover temperature intervals, two-body calorimetry, calorimeter heat capacity, and melting followed by warming.
Two reference cards add Q = mcDeltaT and |Q| = mL with assumptions, mistakes, examples and numeric self-checks.
The coverage generator now inventories all ten configured CBSE subjects as OPEN, uses class-specific syllabus wording, and removes CBSE from optional scope.
The legacy-named coverage JSON is regenerated with snapshot date 2026-11-11. Historical source-inspection dates are preserved; current IB source reads are added.

curriculumBoundaries.economics: Public official SL/HL briefs establish topic headings 2.3, 2.7 and 2.8. They do not certify exact question-level assessment requirements. Quantitative models are explicitly original extensions; no complete unit, paper, IA or HL/SL coverage is claimed.
curriculumBoundaries.physics: Official first-assessment-2025 guide B.1 includes heat-capacity and latent-heat relationships for SL and HL. This repair addresses only selected thermal-transfer skills; other B.1 topics and the full Physics course remain incomplete.
curriculumBoundaries.otherBoards: No AP, IGCSE or full CBSE content completion is inferred from this patch. Their existing course gates remain open.

authorship: All new scenarios, numerical data, explanations and checks are original editorial work. Source URLs provide conceptual references and curriculum context, not copied questions, endorsement or mark schemes.

focusedTests.scope: Content structure, numerical calculations derived from prompt values, subject/topic baseline routing, reproducible coverage and held-body publication filtering.

aiPeerReview.scope: All ten new drills and two formula cards; externality conventions, equations, welfare areas, subsidy wedge, emissions arithmetic, price controls, thermal balances and stated limitations.

scopedEslint.scope: Both authored content files, coverage generator and three changed/new test files.

publicationBoundary.meaning: Prepared source content is removed from learner bundles until exact-item authorised editorial approval. Passing tests and AI peer review are not publication approval.
